info.title: Diffchecker Universal API
info.description: Diffchecker compares text, PDF documents, images, and spreadsheets through a REST API with JSON, HTML, and image-based diff outputs.

get.summary: Compare Documents (HTML JSON, Character, Data URLs)
get.description: Compares documents in Diffchecker and returns a character-level HTML JSON diff from data URLs.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: leftPdf
parameters.description: Left PDF as a data URL.

schema.description: Left PDF as a data URL.

parameters.name: rightPdf
parameters.description: Right PDF as a data URL.

schema.description: Right PDF as a data URL.

css.description: CSS styles for the rendered PDF diff.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.
